resources.string: Televim settings
Televim settings are processed locally on this device. Telegram chats, media and account data are not exported or imported here.
Import desktop settings
Paste the link from your computer and enter the password you chose when exporting. Your settings are processed on this device.
Settings from your computer
Open Televim on your computer.
Go to Settings → Advanced → Transfer local data.
Choose “Transfer settings to Android”, create a QR code and scan it here.
Paste a link

Import accepts one file at a time. Sharing an ordinary JSON file opens normal Telegram chat sending, which uses the network; use Open with to import JSON. For a file, open your device storage in the system Files app. For JSON, choose Open with → Televim. For an encrypted .tgv file, choose Open with or Share → Televim. Only physical local storage from the system provider is accepted. Cloud files, virtual files, and web links are rejected. Encrypted files can be at most 8 MiB; JSON can be at most 2 MiB.
Local settings file
A local file is selected. Enter its export password if encrypted, then preview. A JSON settings file does not need a password.
